summary: Second regression pass after SEC-001 (CORS regex + SameSite=Lax cookies) and SEC-002 (HTML escape in email templates). All 25 backend pytest tests pass, full frontend E2E (register→mark v1+v2→28% progress→logout→admin login→admin dashboard shows new user) verified on preview URL. Both security fixes confirmed working via direct-backend CORS probes and unit tests of email builder functions.

SEC-001_CORS_regex.public_url_note: Public preview URL preflight is intercepted by Cloudflare/ingress which returns ACAO:* WITHOUT Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Browsers reject ACAO:* + credentials, so this is safe. Since frontend is same-origin with API via k8s ingress, no preflight is triggered in practice.

SEC-001_SameSite_Lax.note: Auth cookies set with samesite=lax, secure=true. Full UI flow (login→me→mark→logout) works end-to-end because frontend and /api are same-origin from browser POV.

SEC-002_HTML_escape.build_login_email_html: user_name and user_email are html.escape()'d — , ,
SEC-002_HTML_escape.e2e_test: Registered user with name='Attacker' — stored raw in DB, rendered as text by React in admin dashboard, and escaped in email HTML output.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
auth_utils.get_current_user mutates raw MongoDB doc (assigns user['_id']=str(user['_id'])) — consider returning a Pydantic model.
email_service.send_admin_notification's Resend failures (testing-mode 403) fire on every /tracking/mark; consider throttling or one-time warning to reduce log noise.
CORS_ORIGINS env var fallback to '*' triggers the regex-mode branch — this is fine but the semantic (env='*' means 'use regex') is a footgun; document or rename the env sentinel.
auth_utils.set_auth_cookies still has a stale comment: '# samesite=none + secure=True is required for cross-origin cookies with credentials' — the code now uses samesite='lax', update the comment.
